title: HOPD: Historical On-Policy Distillation for SAR MLLM Continual Learning
title_zh: HOPD：面向合成孔径雷达多模态大语言模型持续学习的历史同策略蒸馏
abstract_en: Continual SAR interpretation requires multimodal large language models to learn incoming sources while retaining earlier task abilities. This is difficult when acquisition and geographic shifts alter visual evidence, regionally concentrated categories bias answers, and historical images are scarce. We address this problem with Historical On-Policy Distillation (HOPD), which reuses source-acquisition LoRA states as persistent teachers for one evolving student. Archiving each state before consolidation preserves a stable source reference. The teachers supervise student-generated prefixes, transferring historical behavior to the student's changing generation contexts. To enrich sparse replay, original-view teachers guide augmented historical student views while preserving spatial coordinates. This knowledge is consolidated into a single deployed adapter that requires no source identity. On SARVQA-CL, our source-incremental evaluation protocol, HOPD achieves the highest final mean score of 54.51 among the compared methods, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.96 points. It also improves the final source-macro score in every evaluated task over shared-memory Replay-SFT, with gains across source orders. These results support source-acquisition history as supervision for retaining earlier task performance during continual SAR adaptation. Code and data: https://github.com/zcablii/HOPD.
abstract_zh: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）持续解译要求多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在适应新数据源的同时保留已有任务能力。采集条件与地理区域的变化会改变视觉证据，类别在特定区域的集中分布可能导致回答偏差，而历史图像又较为稀缺。为此，本文提出历史同策略蒸馏（Historical On-Policy Distillation，HOPD）：在知识整合前归档模型适应各数据源时得到的 LoRA 状态，将其作为持续更新的学生模型的固定教师。教师在学生自行生成的前缀上提供监督，使历史行为能够迁移到不断变化的生成上下文中。为提高少量历史回放样本的利用率，教师以原始视图为输入，指导处理增强视图的学生，同时保持空间坐标一致。最终，知识整合到单一适配器中，推理时无需知道数据源身份。在源增量评测协议 SARVQA-CL 上，HOPD 的最终平均分为 54.51，在对比方法中最高，领先最强基线 2.96 分。相比共享回放存储的 Replay-SFT，HOPD 在所有受评任务上的最终按源宏平均分均有提升，且收益在不同数据源顺序下均可观察到。
key_points_zh: 在知识整合前归档各数据源对应的 LoRA 状态，为持续更新的学生保留稳定的历史教师。
教师基于学生自行生成的前缀提供蒸馏监督，使历史知识适配学生当前的生成上下文。
回放时，教师看原始历史图像，学生看增强视图，并保持空间坐标一致；部署时只需一个适配器，无需数据源标识。
SARVQA-CL 最终平均分达 54.51，领先最强基线 2.96 分；所有受评任务的最终按源宏平均分均高于 Replay-SFT。
